outcome: Duration between initiation of active phase of labor and delivery time (dt1+dt2+dt3)
Initiation time of acceleration stage of the active phase (dt1)
Duration of acceleration stage of the active phase (dt2)
Initiation time of the second phase of labor
cohort: Women in active labor whose progress was monitored using either a classical WHO partogram or a new type partogram.
finding: The new partogram significantly decreased the overall duration of labor from the active phase to delivery and led to earlier initiation and shorter duration of specific labor stages compared to the classical WHO partogram.
